title.zh: 智能合约审计 — Lido（真实语料）

subtitle.en: 161 public smart-contract audits: coverage, unfixed findings, and where the index contradicts itself.
subtitle.zh: 161 份公开审计报告：覆盖情况、未修复项，以及索引自相矛盾之处。

title.en: 130 of 161 carry issue counts; 31 do not
title.zh: 130 / 161 有 issue 数字，31 份没有

claims.claim: 31 entries carry no Total Issues line

ev.note: 31 份无法与其余条目做总量对比；含最老的 12-2020 Sigma Prime
lines: 10-2021 Sigma Prime Easy Track Smart Contract Security Assessment
08-2022 MixBytes Lido Protocol Security Auditor's Review

title.zh: 98 份记录了「Acknowledged」（接受风险、未修复）

claims.claim: 98 entries record a concrete number of Acknowledged findings

ev.note: Acknowledged = 团队接受但不修；索引没有字段说明这些后来有没有被修

title.zh: 矛盾 ①：总数 5，分类加起来 7

claims.section: 01-2022 MixBytes bETH Vault Security Audit Report

ev.note: 分类合计 1+4+2 = 7 ≠ 总数 5；且三类全部 Acknowledged，与「3 Fixed」冲突

title.zh: 矛盾 ②：总数 7，分类加起来 6

claims.section: 02-2025 Trail of Bits Chainlink CSR Security Review

ev.note: 分类合计 1+2+3 = 6 ≠ 总数 7，少一条未列出的发现

title.en: Contradiction 3: 'Notes' counted or not, two rules
title.zh: 矛盾 ③：「Notes」算不算进总数，两份报告口径相反

ev.note: 同一字段名，两条目两种计数口径：一处计入总数，一处不计入
lines: - Total Issues: 9 (4 Risk accepted, 5 Acknowledged)   ← 08-2022 ChainSecurity

q.zh: 这些标为 Acknowledged 的问题，后来修了吗？

gaps.a: The index has no field for whether a later audit resolved an earlier finding.

why.en: 98 entries carry them; the index has no follow-up field.
why.zh: 98 份含 Acknowledged，但没有跟进字段；要回答必须逐份读 PDF

q.en: How many findings do the 31 uncounted reports contain?
q.zh: 31 份报告共发现多少个问题？

gaps.a: 31 of 161 entries carry no Total Issues line.

why.en: Totals are comparable for 130 entries only.
why.zh: 无法做全量总量；只能对 130 份比较

q.en: What does each report body actually say?
q.zh: 每份报告的正文写了什么？

gaps.a: This corpus indexes the README index only; the 161 audit PDFs are not indexed.

why.en: This corpus indexes the README only — every claim points at a README line, not a PDF page.
why.zh: 覆盖边界：这里的每条结论都指向 README 行号，不指向 PDF 页码
